Messages.Author: Lazoth
Messages.Body:
Is the damage done during untap considered to be from the weapon or it is enviromental damage?
The way that it is written, to me, it is evriomental since it not dealt during a strike and is worded like carrion crows.
Also reading 3.17 of the FAQ seems to reflect this.

Cheers from a confused childe

So how do you intend to survive?
Bleed faster

When plumbing the depths of depravity, I must remember to come up for air.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
It is weapon damage. That's why it is often paired with Mictlantecuhtli and Ambrosius the Ferryman because they are immune to weapon damage.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Ambrosius isn't immune to weapon damage. A Flamethrower would kill him.
But Talbot's damage does indeed come from the weapon.

"Environmental" only applies to damage dealt during combat (and is opposed to "from the opposing minion")

Messages.Author: mika
Messages.Body: The source of the damage is equipment, weapon. I think that's the key factor here.
